findings.resolution: Reworded: Meta closed ahead of Alphabet's print; the Deadline report raises the bar.

scope_limits: Checked every cited ID against the own-date feed (title, src, published_at, cat) and every card figure against the own-date card; no other date's feed, card, draft, note or spec was read and no web access was used. Headlines only; article bodies unavailable, so the intraday timing of Feb 1 US after-hours releases (Alphabet, AMD, PayPal, EA, Starbucks) rests on the guardrail list. Analytical judgments (stances, playbook triggers) were checked for consistency, not for correctness. n1413 (stamped 2022-01-27) is used as a lagging currency reference only.
